skeptic-1.evidence: Ideal numerical mass–spring model; no measured hardware data
skeptic-1.statement: Natural frequencies are calculated from the generalized stiffness–mass eigenvalues of an ideal three-mass model.
skeptic-1.caveat: Faithful notation for scipy.linalg.eigh(K,M) and sqrt(vals)/(2*pi), not a separately printed equation in the original Python. No damping, friction, or sensor physics.

echo-rx.evidence: Reduced theoretical mass-balance equation; no biological results
echo-rx.statement: The target compartment receives active mass from a depot and loses it through clearance and spillover.

symbols.name: A_T
symbols.meaning: active protein mass in target pool

symbols.name: A_D
symbols.meaning: active protein mass in depot pool

echo-rx.caveat: Assumes homogeneous linear compartments and fixed rates; does not establish effective biological shutdown, therapeutic exposure or clinical safety.

ghostglass.evidence: Synthetic on/off statistical test; no physical detector validation
ghostglass.sourceLabel: Ghostglass experiment.py · decide() exact conditional test
ghostglass.statement: Computes a conditional on/off Poisson-background tail probability using the binomial survival function.
ghostglass.caveat: BinomSF(k;n,q)=P(X>k) for X~Binomial(n,q). Assumes stationary equal on/off background rates, valid exposures and Poisson counts; not a signal discovery claim.

temporal-acoustics.evidence: Synthetic 2D scalar-wave numerical method; no field measurements
temporal-acoustics.statement: The scalar finite-difference pilot rejects time steps that violate its two-dimensional wave propagation stability bound.
temporal-acoustics.caveat: Transcribed from the code’s strict inequality and separate velocity-field check. A numerical stability constraint, not an acoustic discovery or elastic-earth constitutive law.

chihuahua-sphere-cs-1.evidence: Calculation-only optical energy ledger; hypothetical example
chihuahua-sphere-cs-1.sourceLabel: CS-1 public design note, Intended experiment
chihuahua-sphere-cs-1.equation:
eta_receiver = E_load / E_incident
eta_total = E_load / E_electrical_total
chihuahua-sphere-cs-1.statement: The receiver and whole apparatus have different efficiency denominators. Incident light is an internal transfer, not another output.

symbols.name: E_electrical_total
symbols.meaning: total supplied electrical energy, including actuators (J)

chihuahua-sphere-cs-1.caveat: Notation transcribed from the public prose and hypothetical 10 J / 2 J example. Positive denominators and matched intervals required. No measured efficiency or novel energy gain.

the-traveler-solar-electric-research-air.evidence: Historical passive-drift simulation; no flight or recovery test
the-traveler-solar-electric-research-air.equation:
lap = (abs(lon - lon_start) >= 360 deg)
approach = lap_already_observed AND (d <= r)
the-traveler-solar-electric-research-air.statement: The historical benchmark counts net longitude laps and only counts sampled approaches once a lap has been observed.

symbols.name: lap
symbols.meaning: Boolean lap threshold at a sample

symbols.name: lap_already_observed
symbols.meaning: lap observed at or before current sample

the-traveler-solar-electric-research-air.caveat: Scoring rule, not trajectory planning, steering or flight control. Net longitude is not cumulative absolute path length. Fixed-pressure passive replay; no descent, landing, physical recovery or airspace authorization established.

zion-twin-ring-tuna-habitat.evidence: Dimensionless dye-transport simulation; no physical tank trial
zion-twin-ring-tuna-habitat.sourceLabel: test_gate.py, simulate() return value; bundled README
zion-twin-ring-tuna-habitat.statement: The reported dye metric is the sum of dye concentration in receiving-loop cells divided by the initial total dye sum, expressed as a percentage.

symbols.name: C_receiving
symbols.meaning: sum of dye concentrations in receiving cells at sample time

symbols.name: C_initial
symbols.meaning: initial sum of dye concentrations over all wet cells

zion-twin-ring-tuna-habitat.caveat: Equal-area cells within a run; initial dye sum positive. This metric is distinct from outer-straight circulation and one-way gate flux. Strong mesh dependence, no established physical exchange rate, gate-motion result or animal welfare outcome.

adventurer-s-forge.evidence: Desk-checked tabletop scenario using conventional thermodynamics; no hardware validation
adventurer-s-forge.sourceLabel: UI Worlds playtest v0.3, conventional heat-engine subsystem
adventurer-s-forge.statement: The reversible heat-engine efficiency ceiling depends on the absolute sink and source temperatures.
adventurer-s-forge.caveat: Positive absolute temperatures with T_hot > T_cold; ideal reversible two-reservoir bound. Does not predict real efficiency or establish a fictional energy source, cooling system or working hardware.

crucible.evidence: Recorded held-out synthetic simulation campaign; not hardware reliability evidence
crucible.sourceLabel: CRUCIBLE v0.2 README, Recorded results and held-out design
crucible.statement: The campaign reports the observed violation fraction among conclusive, exercised runs, for example 0/40 for the guarded rover. Invalid, incomplete and not-exercised runs are separately reported.

symbols.name: N_violated
symbols.meaning: number of conclusive exercised runs with contract violations

symbols.name: N_exercised
symbols.meaning: number of conclusive exercised runs in the selected campaign group

crucible.caveat: Notation for the published fractions, not the Wilson confidence interval. Requires positive denominator. Zero observed violations does not imply zero risk. Results apply only to the selected synthetic distribution; no real-world vehicle safety or controller superiority established.

spotrecon-spotrecon-r2.evidence: Design review and illustrative calculation; no field measurements
spotrecon-spotrecon-r2.sourceLabel: SPOTRECON R2 README, Checked illustrative math, observation age
spotrecon-spotrecon-r2.statement: Observation age is the elapsed time between capture and presentation, using a common clock. Age is separate from whether the observation remains correct.
spotrecon-spotrecon-r2.caveat: Transcribed from the printed equation. Timestamps must share a time base; invalid clocks or missing timestamps make age unavailable. Freshness thresholds and accuracy remain unvalidated; no field performance, reservation or aviation approval established.

confluence-01-synthetic-sense.evidence: Proposed evaluation metric; no prototype or dataset
confluence-01-synthetic-sense.sourceLabel: CONFLUENCE-01 README, Tests before claims, item 4
confluence-01-synthetic-sense.statement: Notation for the proposed reporting metric of false events per valid observation hour. Compare only under declared event definitions, with ground truth and coverage separately reported.

symbols.name: N_false
symbols.meaning: count of false events within valid observation periods

symbols.name: T_valid_hours
symbols.meaning: total duration of valid observation periods (hours)

confluence-01-synthetic-sense.caveat: Formalization of the proposed prose metric, not a printed or tested equation in the project. Positive valid duration required. Abstention and coverage must remain visible; excluding unavailable periods can hide failures. No new sensory modality, diagnostic accuracy or safety benefit established.

spincell-dle.evidence: Illustrated concept; proposed material-accounting metric without paired assays
spincell-dle.sourceLabel: SpinCell DLE public note, Evidence and Proposed next check
spincell-dle.statement: Notation for the proposed lithium recovery accounting: compare the mass of lithium recovered in the designated product stream with the incoming lithium mass for the same batch.

symbols.name: R_Li
symbols.meaning: fraction of incoming lithium recovered in designated product

symbols.name: m_Li_recovered
symbols.meaning: lithium mass in the designated recovered product stream

symbols.name: m_Li_in
symbols.meaning: lithium mass entering the same defined batch boundary

spincell-dle.caveat: Formalization of the public note's proposed recovery metric, not a measured result or printed source equation. Positive input mass required; account for other outlets and inventory changes, and report uncertainty. Recovery is not concentration, selectivity or energy efficiency. No process chemistry, operating parameters or demonstrated extraction performance.
